conbody.p: The Lane Departure Warning is issued through a green indicator light on the instrument cluster, a blinking indicator in the direction you departed from, an audible warning sound and steering wheel vibration (if equipped).
Lane Departure Warning can activate in the following conditions.

li.p: Your driving speed: Approximately 60-200 km/h (40-120 mph)
Road conditions meet the operating requirements (e.g., lane width, road curvature, etc.)
